svg.title: Reverse Engineering Browser system architecture
svg.desc: An icon-based architecture diagram in the original reference style. Native probes feed MPSC renderer queues and the browser bridge. Authenticated event and artifact channels persist evidence and immutable blobs for Origin Trace. A separate optional debugger path supports live inspection and disposable experiments.
svg.text: Local browser instrumentation and research harness
Native capture stays outside page JavaScript.
Local evidence stays separate from interpretation.
Native quiet mode omits CDP; native evidence and captured Sources remain available.
Disabled by default · category scope · expiration
Bounded queues · explicit drops and failures
Metadata by default · authorized artifact capture
General agent SDK · exact value provenance
Capture and analysis paths are implemented; full Brave compilation requires the pinned upstream toolchain.
